decision.rationale: TXN-008121 posted on 2026-09-23. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 32 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 27808 cents (278.08 EUR). The authorised amount on AUTH-008309 is also 27808 cents, an ecommerce payment authenticated with 3-D Secure. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder says the quote was 180.76 EUR, which would make a 97.32 EUR difference, but that is a claim, not a receipt. The posted amount matches the authorised amount and there is no receipt, so under amount-no-receipt nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. The merchant's receipt or order details are needed.

proposed_actions.note: Please send the receipt or order details for the 278.08 EUR purchase on 2026-09-22. They should show the amount the customer agreed to pay.
